messages.subject: Responsive breakpoints in fluidrow
parts:
Hi Everyone:

Is there a way to assign a breakpoint such that the elements in `fluidRow` will respond at a given browser width?

I am working on an app using shinydashboard and the `box` widget.
The problem is when I have 3 `box` elements in a `fluidRow` with the `width=4` the box reflow too late,
and there is an awkward period where the contents of the `box` begin to look too squished.

I believe the proper way to do this is to use CSS media querries, but I cannot seem to get the settings correct.
I should be able to add a `class` element to the `box` or `fluidRow` and have different CSS elements in the header as follows:

    singleton(tags$head(tags$link(rel='stylesheet',
                                            media='(max-width: 700)',
                                            href='screen_narrow.css',
                                            type='text/css')))

Do I assign a CSS rule to the `fluidRow` or to the `box` element?

I believe the other way is to have some kind of reactive client-server-client variable that will assign the `width` parameter in `box` to 4 if the browser is wide, and 12 if it meets some threshold width.


Thanks for the help,
Dan

messages.subject: Re: Responsive breakpoints in fluidrow
parts:
You can try using custom container classes using the "Grid system" section of http://getbootstrap.com/css/ as a guide, for example:

div(class="col-md-3 col-sm-4",
   ...
)

for a div that would take 3/12 of the available width on desktop browsers, 4/12 of the width for tablets, and 12/12 for phones.
